description:
Proposed PR6: attach_documents selection Action, authorization/provenance, opaque aliases, request-local attachment selection and ordinary Agent propagation. Setup/planning only; no feature code or existing tests changed.

## Stack and ownership
Worktree ../zaq-feat-attach-documents; branch feat/attach-documents. Created from feat/delivery-execution at exact parent SHA 81629c90a555b32c6b66cbcc1339779c89f4a9d5 on 2026-11-27. This SHA is the previous-parent boundary for a future authorized restack after PR5 advances. No PR6 feature commits exist. Capture the future PR5 tip and PR6 recovery ref, then use the recorded old boundary when restacking; do not use a moving merge-base as a substitute. No restack is authorized by this planning request. PR5's uncommitted mix.lock delta was excluded and left untouched. Never modify/rebase PR5 or edit its issue content/status; only the explicitly required dependency edge into PR6 is added.
Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files at 8d987fa5c61e83b86d22f6a9f7597c4506dd5999 supplies source/test evidence, not authority over revised contracts. PR4 zaq-6rc description and PR5 zaq-9j8 approved contracts/zaq-9j8.2 govern. PR4 Outgoing.attachments and canonical builder are already present; Plan is separate, metadata-only and Channel-local. PR5 later supplies the existing transport route, preparations, execution, confirmation and grouped outcomes.

## Discovery and reuse decisions
Inspected existing zaq-383, zaq-rn4.3, zaq-6rc.8/.10, zaq-6rc and zaq-9j8 plus its execution/API contracts before creating issues. zaq-6rc.8/.10 are closed scope-removal placeholders, not completed PR6 implementations. zaq-rn4.3 belongs to the obsolete four-PR redistribution and includes PR7 consumers; retain it as historical evidence and do not reopen or duplicate that stack. No current PR6 epic exists.
Source audit: current Registry has no attach_documents operation; GetDocument fetches current authorized metadata via DataSourceTool/Channels; DownloadDocument materializes content and is not selection. Record.Authorization owns permission-principal precedence; Provenance currently signs a different provider projection, so nested effective-principal changes must be bound and tested. OpaqueAliases already traverses schema-declared input/output paths; extend it for private output expansion. StreamEvents owns request-local reduction/replay/termination; Executor -> Factory.ask_with_config is the configured-agent path, and Outgoing.from_pipeline_result is the canonical output builder. Workflow Steps contain no competing attachment-selection operation. Action macro provides validated schemas/hooks; native tool use is explicitly allowlisted, never implied by workflow compatibility.
New Action: Zaq.Agent.Tools.DataSource.AttachDocuments with meaningful selection-only schema; reuse GetDocument through ActionContract/Jido.Exec validated execution, Record/Provenance/Authorization and TrustedContext. Extend existing alias/lifecycle/propagation owners, with the pure selection reducer local to AttachDocuments. No new delivery Action, selection state process, generic invocation route or duplicate provider/ACL implementation.

## Required adaptations and acceptance
1. Use Outgoing.attachments only; never port Outgoing.Delivery, delivery.error, Agent plans or prepared payloads. No selection-stage transport validation, file-size filtering, file acquisition or failure-notice send path. Include all valid selected Records; PR5 applies selected-connection settings and transport policy later.
2. Trusted context.actor is the caller identity. ActorNormalizer and literal top-level skip_permissions == true are authoritative; no flat person_id/team_ids, model-supplied actor or nil-identity elevation. Enforce file kind and authentic provenance even for explicitly privileged callers. Data-source selections refresh current authorized metadata with signed provider/config/file claims; generic signed Records require current Record authorization.
3. Add/remove/replace apply atomically per authorized instruction in native declaration order. Authorization failure rejects that instruction and leaves prior selection intact; successful earlier/later calls survive partial failure across calls. add deduplicates stable source identity; remove only deselects; replace [] clears exactly. Same ID on different provider/config scopes never collapses. Failed/malformed calls stay tool feedback/private safe evidence, do not clear valid selection or poison transport. A successful retry has ordinary successful selection semantics.
4. Only a current pending native request can select. Match trusted tool/invocation identity and ignore replay, foreign-request, late and post-terminal events. Alias lifetime stays logical-server-scoped; selection lifetime stays request-scoped. Failure, cancellation, worker exit, suppressed/partial error, handoff and next-request paths cannot publish or leak selected files. Existing text/trace/steering behavior remains intact.
5. Successful configured Agent results carry only the final verified Record list through StreamEvents -> Executor -> canonical Outgoing builder -> Agent role result. Empty/no-tool runs are ordinary text; incoming files never echo automatically. Model output/public status/history diagnostics must not expose full handles, provenance capabilities, raw content or runtime context.
6. A late PR5-dependent backend integration proves the final B selection (after add A/add B/remove A) is the only file materialized/sent through the existing route and confirmations reflect actual provider outcomes. Preserve PR5 failure policies, timeout/uncertainty distinctions and no automatic retries; tool success never claims delivery.

## Scope exclusions
No PR5 runtime/bridge/SMTP/outcome implementation, new transport/settings/resolver, adapter pin changes, Outgoing wrapper, or Engine persistence redesign. No edits to RunAgent, NotifyPerson, Engine Notifications, workflow Steps, notification tools or workflow execution; those are PR7. No new BO screens or browser UX, so immediate backend integration/property tests cover PR6 and no new browser E2E is currently needed. If scope later adds UI, create/reuse an explicit human UX approval -> consolidated E2E gate before E2E authoring.

## Setup evidence and limitations
Branch and tracked tree match the captured parent. Ignored config/dev.secret.exs copied byte-for-byte without displaying contents. Effective dev database read through Config.Reader: zaq_feat_attach_documents. Worktree-setup stops at step 5: source .claude/settings.local.json is absent. No substitute, mix setup, dependency fetch, database creation/migrations, seed or asset build was performed. Application environment is not ready. Do not write PR5 to repair the missing file. Context Mode execution/search/storage work, but doctor reports absent Codex hooks flag/config; automatic session capture is unverified and user-level integration configuration was not changed. Serena initial instructions/readiness and reference semantic queries worked, but some new-worktree source overviews returned empty/stalled; bounded targeted reads/diffs supplied evidence. Do not claim complete tooling readiness.

## Sequencing
Task IDs and graph are appended after issue creation. PR5 gates only PR6's transport integration, not planning or the independent selection work. The setup task is the PR6 starting issue. Epic remains in_progress for planning, implementation tasks open. All tasks specify functional/files, tests before implementation, branches, mocking, documentation and Action reuse. Review precedes dedicated coverage-upper/final validation; final human approval and publication remain future authorization gates.


Implementation constraints: This is a proposed plan only. The current request authorizes setup and Beadwork planning, not implementation, commits, pushes, rebases or publication. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md before later execution; read the owning service guide and each touched module's @moduledoc. Agent work also follows docs/services/agent.md#harness-critical-checks-for-coding-agents. Recheck live source/contracts after PR5 advances. Preserve existing test behavior; if an assertion/scenario must change, record old/proposed behavior and obtain specific human approval first. No such changes are approved here. New unit/integration/property tests are immediate and written before production code. Keep real internal boundaries and isolated fixture/process state; inject runtime dependencies through established opts/context and Zaq.Config.get/4 where relevant, without global configuration mutation. Follow the authoritative validation lifecycle in docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; do not treat historical/reference runs as current validation. PR5 owns delivery execution/outcomes; PR7 owns RunAgent, NotifyPerson and notification/workflow integration.
